prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective walking along Castle Rock Beach in Meelup, Australia, under a clear sunny sky during the day. The camera moves steadily forward, capturing the pristine white sand interspersed with scattered reddish-brown rocks and patches of green vegetation. As the viewer progresses, a blue canopy tent appears on the right side, providing shade over a small seating area. The camera continues along the beach, revealing more of the tranquil shoreline bordered by dense greenery. The path then transitions from the sandy beach onto a rocky trail, winding through lush foliage and trees that cast dappled shadows on the ground. The camera angle shifts slightly upward, showcasing the vibrant blue sky peeking through the canopy. The natural light filters through the leaves, creating a play of light and shadow on the rugged terrain. The scene remains empty, emphasizing the serene and untouched beauty of the outdoor environment. The camera maintains a smooth, continuous movement, offering an immersive experience of exploring this picturesque coastal landscape.
